name: Gotify
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Gotify is a simple server for sending and receiving push notifications over a REST API and WebSocket. The first user's password is the one you set, or a random one shown in the console on the first start.
startup: if [ ! -f data/gotify.db ] && [ -z "${ADMIN_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then ADMIN_PASSWORD=$(tr -dc A-Za-z0-9 </dev/urandom | head -c 20); echo "Gotify's first user is {{ADMIN_USERNAME}}, with the password $ADMIN_PASSWORD. Log in and change it."; fi; GOTIFY_SERVER_PORT={{SERVER_PORT}} GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_NAME="{{ADMIN_USERNAME}}" GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_PASS="$ADMIN_PASSWORD" GOTIFY_REGISTRATION=false exec ./gotify

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Gotify: downloads the Gotify server from its GitHub releases, checked
# against GitHub's SHA-256. The data folder (database, images, plugins)
# and config.yml are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is
# small), removed when the script ends.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) echo "Gotify has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))."; exit 1 ;;
esac

version="${VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$version" = latest ] || version="v${version#v}"
# gh-release says why when the release doesn't exist or GitHub can't be reached.
tag=$(gh-release tag gotify/server "$version") || exit 1

if [ -x gotify ] && [ "$(cat .gotify-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "Gotify $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Gotify $tag."
    gh-release download gotify/server "$tag" "gotify-linux-${arch}.zip" $work/gotify.zip
    unzip -qo $work/gotify.zip -d $work/gotify
    install -m 0755 "$work/gotify/gotify-linux-${arch}" gotify.new
    mv -f gotify.new gotify
    echo "$tag" > .gotify-version
fi
mkdir -p data
echo "Installed Gotify $tag."
